artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: pre-deploy snapshot and baseline materialization, deploy-headless.sh, targeted post-deploy acceptance checks, sanctioned install-once settings.json hand-edit, baseline-relative verify-deploy comparison, change-log and deferred-decision record.

notes: Pre-deploy verify-deploy baseline is NOT re-captured; Phase 1 transcribes research report Section 4 verbatim to disk before Phase 2 deploys.
Acceptance criterion is mechanical and baseline-relative: comm -13 pre-deploy post-deploy must be empty. A non-empty post-deploy findings set is explicitly not a failure.

Phase 4 is the single sanctioned source-store-boundary exception (install-once settings.json); it forbids editing the already-correct source copy and requires the hook reasoning be recorded in writing.

MEASURED CORRECTION to the dispatch brief: CHANGE_LOG.md is at specs/CHANGE_LOG.md, i.e. INSIDE specs/**, where task numbers are exempt, and its existing entries use 'Task N:' headings. The no-task-numbers constraint is still honored in the strictest direction (durable anchors only), and the plan records this reasoning so the implementer does not reverse it mid-phase.

Phase 3 carries the concrete mint-dispatch-seq acceptance check: deployed skill-base.sh must contain jq -r '(.dispatch_seq_counter // 0) + 1' and no ambient-increment form, plus a run of the newly-deployed test-mint-dispatch-seq.sh.
Phase 3 also covers the research-flagged gate5 blind spot by hand-diffing both manifest.json files and one literature context doc that gate5 never compares.
Both deferred decisions (lean-lsp user-scope BimodalLogic mis-registration; nine duplicated playwright grants) are recorded with reasons in Phase 6; no settings fragment is edited.
Fresh-session MCP registration verification is recorded as a manual out-of-session follow-up, not an in-task gate.
